title: Effect of lanthanide contraction and rigid ligand on the structure of salen-type lanthanide complexes

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of PrCl3·6H2O (0.0710 g, 0.2 mmol) and Zn(OAc)2·2H2O (0.0440 g, 0.2 mmol) was dissolved in CH3OH (10 ml) and added to a CH2Cl2 (5 ml) solution of H2L (0.0376 g, 0.1 mmol). The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 24 h, then diethyl ether was allowed to diffuse slowly into the filtrate. Crystals of 1 were obtained in 10 days.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: self-assembly in mixed solvent followed by diethyl ether vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtrate subjected to slow diethyl ether diffusion to give crystals of 1 in 10 days

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to 1: a mixture of TbCl3·6H2O and Zn(OAc)2·2H2O in CH3OH was added to H2L in CH2Cl2, stirred at room temperature for 24 h, and crystallized by slow diethyl ether diffusion into the filtrate. The paper states that similar synthetic methods were conducted for 2–4, using the quantified procedure given for 1.

properties.summary: In MeOH at room temperature, 2 shows characteristic Tb3+ metal-centred luminescence assigned to 5D4 → 7FJ transitions, indicating ligand-to-Tb energy transfer.
